title: Assumption Testing
equation: Plan Robustness = (Assumptions Tested + Cost-to-Falsify + Decision Hooks) ÷ 3
hook: Your whole plan is probably sitting on one assumption nobody has actually checked.
statement: Find and test your riskiest assumptions before you put serious money behind the plan.
explainer: Most strategies fail because nobody tested a cheap assumption early. Spend in stages, and only release the next chunk once the last milestone proves its assumption right.
sop: List every assumption your plan depends on.
Rank them by risk and by cost to test.
Design the cheapest test for each top risk.
Run the tests before you commit big money.
Update the plan based on what you learn.
equation_example: Score each 1 to 10. Assumptions Tested 6, Cost-to-Falsify 8, Decision Hooks 5. (6 + 8 + 5) ÷ 3 = 6.3. Higher means your plan rests on evidence. Lower means it rests on assumptions nobody has poked at.
question: Write down your riskiest assumption and the cheapest way to test it this week.
closing_statement: Untested assumptions are bets you didn't know you made.
caption:
Principle Nº 310: Assumption Testing

Your whole plan is probably sitting on one assumption nobody has actually checked.

Find and test your riskiest assumptions before you put serious money behind the plan.

Your turn: Write down your riskiest assumption and the cheapest way to test it this week.
